thesis: Spiritual and philosophical traditions examine desire, reflection and relational formation without one shared doctrine.

ideas.statement: Practices that help vulnerable people resist may become tools of imposed adaptation; inner freedom and external freedom must support rather than excuse the loss of each other.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Comparisons preserve differences; critique of an independent self does not erase practical continuity or responsibility, and support must allow unwanted choices.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Comparisons preserve differences; critique of an independent self does not erase practical continuity or responsibility, and support must allow unwanted choices.

audit.notes: Every batch unit read by active LLM; thought experiments, scope and normative distinctions preserved.
